ui.settings.page.title.note: The Settings page's own title. Short; it sits beside a gear icon.

ui.settings.profile.description_anonymou.note: Same opening as the authenticated variant minus the account sentence; the two must not diverge in wording for the shared part.

ui.settings.profile.description_authenti.note: Reads as one paragraph. Second sentence says the details come from the Radient account.

ui.settings.profile.display_name.label.note: A short field label above an input.

ui.settings.profile.display_name.placeho.note: Shown in an empty text input; ends with an ellipsis.

ui.settings.profile.email.label.note: A short field label above an input.

ui.settings.profile.email.placeholder.note: Shown in an empty text input; ends with an ellipsis.

ui.settings.profile.title.note: Names the section holding display name and email.

ui.settings.section.interface_language.h.note: Says the setting is shared with the terminal and that 'auto' follows the OS, falling back to English. The literal token `auto` names a picker option and must stay untranslated.

ui.settings.section.interface_language.l.note: Must contain the word for 'language' so the settings search finds it; scoped to the whole app.

ui.settings.tour.action.note: Starts the onboarding tour. Sits beside a play-in-circle icon.

ui.settings.tour.description.note: Asks whether the reader missed or wants a refresher, then says to start it here.

ui.settings.tour.title.note: Names the section that restarts the onboarding tour.
